==Description==
The '''Turkey Leg''' is an event consumable that can be obtained from the [[Null & Void Event]] and formerly from the [[Hexscape Event]]. It can be used to regenerate base health. It can be obtained from the [[Low Grade Crate]] and [[Mid Grade Crate]].

Only up to four '''Turkey Legs''' can be used by a player in a single match. It has a 60 second cooldown with a 10 second initial cooldown.

==Usage==
When using the '''Turkey Leg''', a turkey leg will appear in the player's hand, which will be eaten by it upon use. This will heal back 100 health for the base health. As this consumable has four uses, it can be used to regenerate up to 400 health. It can increase base health to be higher than its max health if the Over-Heal [[Skills|Skill]] is unlocked.

==Appearance==
The '''Turkey Leg''' takes the appearance of a wide brown baked turkey leg. 

==Strategy==
*The '''Turkey Leg''' can be used to regenerate lost base health, though as this is generally not necessary.
**If one player in the match has the [[Medic]], the '''Turkey Leg''' is not needed at all, as the [[Medic]] can heal back more health than it in most situations.
